summary: Apyx Medical filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, disclosing a press release on new clinical data published in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery Global Open. The prospective study (n=6 at Day 180) evaluated Renuvion helium plasma radiofrequency on biological markers of skin quality, citing a 30% increase in elastin fiber density, 55% higher elastin staining intensity, 34% reduced inflammation, and 27% increased elastin expression versus control. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. This is a routine product/clinical-results current report, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
